---
name: compliance-engineering
description: Use only when a project explicitly adopts a compliance regime or concrete regulated-data obligations and needs engineering evidence mapped to those obligations.
---

# Compliance Engineering

Start from explicit applicability. Do not infer HIPAA, PCI, SOX, GDPR, or another regime from industry vocabulary alone.

For an adopted regime:
- map each obligation to a concrete system behavior/control
- identify evidence and ownership
- separate automated checks from reviewed/advisory controls
- record exceptions and residual risk
- avoid claiming legal compliance from technical checks alone
